text: As the parameter $q \to 1$, the quantum group $U_q(\mathfrak{sl}_2)$ degenerates to the classical universal enveloping algebra $\mathcal{U}(\mathfrak{sl}_2)$.
explanation: The chapter shows $\frac{q^H - q^{-H}}{q - q^{-1}} \to H$ as $q \to 1$, so the $q$-deformed relation $[E,F]=\frac{q^H-q^{-H}}{q-q^{-1}}$ collapses to the classical $[E,F]=H$. This is exactly why $U_q(\mathfrak{g})$ is called a $q$-deformation of $\mathcal{U}(\mathfrak{g})$.
